name: 1Password
description: Bots sign in to websites with logins and one-time codes from the 1Password vaults you choose.

setupFields.label: Service account token
setupFields.helpText: Shown once when you create the service account in step 2.

installationSteps: Put the logins bots should use in a 1Password vault other than Personal, Private, Employee, or the default Shared vault. Service accounts can't open those.
On 1Password.com, go to Developer → Directory → Other → Create a Service Account. Add that vault with read access only, then copy the token. 1Password shows it only once.
Paste the token below and add the plugin. Every bot can then use those logins; passwords and codes a bot reads appear in its conversation.
To rotate the token, paste the new one on this page. Uninstalling deletes it from OpenTeam; delete the service account in 1Password to revoke access.

skills.name: 1password
skills.description: Sign in to websites with the user's saved 1Password logins and one-time codes. Use whenever a site asks for a username, password, or verification code.
